description: Re-reads one offer from the search cache and refreshes its badge/action against current mandate state. Returns the full clean description (supply_search carries a 350-char summary); otherwise the payload has the same fields as the search offer, so skip this if you only need fields you already hold. include_description_original=true adds description_original {format, content}, the merchant's own markup (untrusted), or description_original_omitted with the reason. Carries no shipping data: use supply_delivery for ETA and cost. Re-run supply_search if offer_not_in_cache.

agent_id.description: Agent id to refresh badge/action for mandate state

include_description_original.description: Adds description_original {format, content}: the merchant's own markup, for rendering or checking our conversion. Untrusted merchant text. supply_details only.

session_token.description: Session token from agent_authenticate — required whenever agent_id is passed

supply_id.description: Offer supply id from supply_search results

name: supply_details

description_original.description: Only with include_description_original. The merchant's markup, untrusted. format is html or markdown today; plain is reserved.

description_original_omitted.description: Only with include_description_original, when there is no original: no_markup (plain text or none), oversize (over 20,000 chars), empty (markup with no visible text).

title: Get supply details
